Fetches Oracle Linux OVAL security data from the official Oracle Linux security feed.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `newFetchRequests` | `func` | Builds the fetch request slice targeting the Oracle ELSA bzip2 OVAL feed |
| `FetchFiles` | `func` | Public entry point; fetches and returns OVAL feed results or a wrapped error |

## Usage Example

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "log"

    "github.com/vulsio/goval-dictionary/fetcher/oracle"
)

func main() {
    results, err := oracle.FetchFiles()
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatalf("failed to fetch Oracle OVAL data: %v", err)
    }

    for _, r := range results {
        fmt.Printf("Fetched %d bytes from %s\n", len(r.Body), r.URL)
    }
}
```

## Notes

- The feed URL is hardcoded to `https://linux.oracle.com/security/oval/com.oracle.elsa-all.xml.bz2`
- The payload is expected to be `bzip2`-compressed; `util.MIMETypeBzip2` signals the downloader to decompress automatically
- Errors are wrapped with `golang.org/x/xerrors` for structured error chaining
- Source: [`oracle.go`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/oracle.go)
